answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 1782 Country: United Kingdom Title: Can a Muslim or muslims who are blessed with entering Jannah choose their wives ? If they were not married in the dunya can they choose their wives and if they were married, can they choose different ones? Question: Salaamu Alaikum Wa RahmutAllah. Can a Muslim or muslims who are blessed with entering Jannah choose their wives ? If they were not married in the dunya can they choose their wives and if they were married, can they choose different ones? JazakAllah Khayr. Answer ID: 1782 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1100/1026=B) Those who will be blessed with Paradise will get beautiful Houris as wives whether they had been married in the world or unmarried. They will never look to other women while having Houris as their wives. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
